tips.text: Check the recipe wants five built Fieldron, not Fieldron Samples, before buying the blueprint.
Take Fieldron from Invasions or level 30 to 50 Vallis bounties instead of crafting five at 12 hours each.
Join an established clan with a finished Dojo instead of funding the Energy Lab research yourself.
Nobody complains about this weapon's farm; the pain is Forma and Fieldron across many Dojo weapons.
